---
title: "Choropleth Map"
author: "Kieran Hefferan"
date: "2026-06-07"
output: html_document
---

```{r data-load}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)

# Load data
election_raw <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/Redma/OneDrive/Documents/countypresidential_election_2000-2020.csv")
fips_geo <- read.csv("C:/Users/Redma/OneDrive/Documents/fips2geocode.csv")

# 2020 Democrat + Republican county vote data
election_2020 <- election_raw %>%
  filter(year == 2020,
         party %in% c("DEMOCRAT", "REPUBLICAN")) %>%
  select(year, state_po, county_name, county_fips, party, candidatevotes) %>%
  mutate(
    county_fips = str_pad(as.character(county_fips), width = 5, pad = "0"),
    candidatevotes = as.numeric(candidatevotes)
  )

# Format FIPS geocode data
fips_geo_clean <- fips_geo %>%
  mutate(
    county_fips = str_pad(as.character(fips), width = 5, pad = "0"),
    lon = as.numeric(lon),
    lat = as.numeric(lat)
  )

# Merge election data with geocode data
election_geo <- election_2020 %>%
  left_join(fips_geo_clean, by = "county_fips")

# Create county-level winner dataset
county_results <- election_geo %>%
  group_by(year, state_po, county_name, county_fips, party) %>%
  summarise(
    candidatevotes = sum(candidatevotes, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = first(lon),
    lat = first(lat),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(county_fips) %>%
  mutate(
    total_two_party_votes = sum(candidatevotes),
    vote_share = candidatevotes / total_two_party_votes
  ) %>%
  slice_max(candidatevotes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    winner_code = ifelse(party == "DEMOCRAT", 0, 1),
    hover_text = paste0(
      county_name, ", ", state_po,
      "<br>Winning party: ", party,
      "<br>Votes: ", scales::comma(candidatevotes),
      "<br>Two-party vote share: ", scales::percent(vote_share, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

# County boundary GeoJSON for choropleth
counties_geojson <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/geojson-counties-fips.json",
  simplifyVector = FALSE
)

# Interactive choropleth map
plot_ly(
  data = county_results,
  type = "choropleth",
  geojson = counties_geojson,
  locations = ~county_fips,
  z = ~winner_code,
  colorscale = list(
    c(0, "blue"),
    c(1, "red")
  ),
  zmin = 0,
  zmax = 1,
  text = ~hover_text,
  hoverinfo = "text",
  marker = list(line = list(width = 0)),
  colorbar = list(
    title = "Winning Party",
    tickvals = c(0, 1),
    ticktext = c("Democrat", "Republican")
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = "2020 Presidential Election Results by County",
    geo = list(
      scope = "usa",
      projection = list(type = "albers usa"),
      showlakes = TRUE,
      lakecolor = "white"
    )
  
  )
```
